notes.title: Inspire the Next Generation of Dungeon Creators
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157733/4451bd91ffce44c20a61b16850b3133cf8bad5cf.png"][/img]Take dungeon creation into your own hands in Create Mode, where you are given the tools to create the dungeons of your dreams—and someone else’s nightmares. All of the dungeons in King of Meat have been made with the same tools that you will use to create your own fiendish playgrounds. If you can play it, you can build it.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Some call dungeons the original occupational hazard. Others, malicious compliance. For Komstruct, it’s just another Monday. As the company whose job it is to empower Dungeon Creators to build unpredictable dungeons, Komstruct takes everything about King of Meat very seriously. Especially themselves. Top performers often work themselves to the bone, which has proven to be one of the greatest conservation efforts for endangered skeleton populations. How far will you go to become the most celebrated Dungeon Creator in all of Loregok?[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Now for more details about Create Mode, say hi to the face of Komstruct, literally. Buzzworth Billy![/p][p][img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/z4mnmfs6j6sv/7BLd4hBygXxVgwRFycHJ12/93e262380edd36769a7469736b8f6f6e/KOM_2D_Cutouts_Billy.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Come Build With Me... Forever[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Dungeon Creators! Your beloved Buzzworth Billy here. Komstruct is dying for new deranged dungeon designs. Build your wonderfully wicked creations and show those awe-inspiring Contenders such a good time that they’ll never leave, but not by choice.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Create 101[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Entry-level builders often ask, Billy how can I go from dull dungeon designs to devilishly sharp features such as yourself? I’m pleased to introduce Komstruct’s latest new hire orientation videos, Create Mode 101.[/p][previewyoutube="ZFNo6y6btRA;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Behold the many tools you’ll need to make a reflection of your darkest, innermost desires, or maybe that’s just me.[/p][list][*][p][b]Room Creation:[/b] From breakable walls to passages that require eliminating enemies or activating switches, there are seemingly endless ways to craft your dungeon entrance and exit together.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Geometry: [/b]Towers, holes, slopes, and more. Geometry adds another dimension to your dungeon by letting you remove floor tiles or alter their height.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enemies: [/b]Your allies, including Skeletons, the literal backbone of every creation, will stop at nothing to defend your dungeon. Whether you prefer aggressive, support, or ranged enemies, there are even ways to get creative with spawns.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Logic Mode: [/b]Link clever contraptions to switches, pressure plates, and more. How will you use Logic Mode to create unique actions throughout your dungeon?[/p][/*][*][p][b]Decorations, Props, Objects, and Lighting: [/b]Style can make or break a dungeon. Why do you think I haven’t washed this red stuff off my costume yet? Props are more than just decorations, especially every aspiring Dungeon Creator’s favorite sub-category, traps.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p align="start"]It’s not easy for Komstruct to maintain high viewership while death by misadventure plagues their target audience, but Komstruct has good intentions. They never hesitate to help Contenders overcome traumas live on global broadcasts. Create Mode, an intuitive technological breakthrough in dungeon design, empowers aspiring Dungeon Creators to do their worst thanks to state of the art traps.[/p][previewyoutube="TX4PDBXGzhc;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Do you like explosive barrels? Create a room with slopes and enough explosive barrels to challenge any Contenders determined to finish your dungeon with as few jumps as possible. How about platforming? Add bottomless pits with rotating spikes, barrages of arrows, and swinging platforms that lead to multiple switches. Shh! One switch opens a secret passage crowded with tantalizing saws, wink, while another reverses the direction of the rotating spikes.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Speaking of surprises, Contenders will scour your playground for that sweet, sweet gold and glory. But watch out! Some secrets, like the padlock on the back of my mascot costume, are better left undiscovered. It’s because Komstruct trusts me so much, not because I can’t reach it. With eight of us inside the suit, there are always opportunities for me time, but never enough chances to make new friends.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Komstructor Collective[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Want to make a real difference in the lives of Loregokish everywhere? Share your dungeon on the [b][u][url="https://www.kingofmeat.com/en-us/forward-link?id=discord"]King of Meat Discord server[/url][/u][/b] for a chance to join my merry mayhem makers forever and ever and ever. I can't wait to see what lurks inside your beautiful mind. Check out our [b][u][url="https://www.kingofmeat.com/en-us/community/komstructor-collective"]Komstructor Collective page[/url][/u][/b] for an overview of exclusive membership benefits, rewards, and more. Together we’ll show them Komstruct cares. We'll show them all.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Komstruct Cares[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Page 10,672 of the seventh edition Komstruct employee manual states top performing Dungeon Creators design consistent levels around different themes, mechanics, or even enemies. Part of the fun is never knowing what to expect. Experienced Creators often start with a simple concept and steadily add complexity throughout their dungeon. Those are the ones you'll want to follow in compliance with Komstruct Kore Principles like Kamaraderie. The more levels you play, the more inspiration and experience you'll gather. If that weren't the case, why would the mandatory dungeon simulator always have a queue during optional lunch hours?[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Recent studies show severe cases of pleasure from the misfortune of others in younger Dungeon Creators. Celebrate the misfortune of those in your dungeon, firmly smile as they outwit your favourite obstacle in seconds, and then scheme. Scheme ridiculous traps like lava-spitting skulls to ensure they fail your next creation again and again until every dwindling flame becomes a scalding reminder that their child’s sixteenth birthday party will start any minute now.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Afterwards they will always cherish those delightfully dreadful hours, and hopefully prioritise their family, whenever they see a dungeon with your name on it. Komstruct neither supports nor refutes this design philosophy.[/p][previewyoutube="gL0Z2EYNjk4;full"][/previewyoutube][p]I can’t wait for us to play together when King of Meat releases on October 7.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Aspiring Contenders can [b][u][url="https://www.kingofmeat.com/en-us/shop"]pre-order[/url][/u][/b] King of Meat: Standard Edition or King of Meat: Deluxe Edition now for bonus content like the Venerable Defender Legendary Costume, a fearsome samurai-style outfit, with matching sword, shield, and stickers, plus up to 5 days of early access.[/p]

notes.title: Become the Ultimate Contender
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157733/e2de69655bf01bd0680c0e9016a6c8df569c9f67.png"][/img][/p][p]In the world of Loregok, where flocks of local dragons hunger for fame, neighbourhood trolls crave funds to pay rent, and global corporate commercialism thirsts to quench its bottom line, comes a fresh source of raw entertainment—you.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Some of you yearn for the spotlight as Contenders. Others may have taken a wrong turn on their way to the restroom. Those desperately seeking fame and fortune can enter joyfully unhinged dungeons built by both the developers and the community. From outrageous waves of enemies to outrageous enemies on waves, nothing is off the table in King of Meat.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Conquer the seemingly endless catalogue of devious dungeons to unlock new leagues, challenges, and more. However, completion alone isn’t enough. Whether you are crowned victorious or perish anonymously, you’ll need to impress your audience with stylish weapons, combos, and over-the-top Glory Moves. Here’s Coach Yurgurt to help you become the ultimate contender.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Meet Coach Yurgurt[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Welcome to King of Meat! I’m Coach Yurgurt, legendary rookie, all-star veteran, and the most overqualified coach in all of Loregok. Not that I need an introduction. This is the most exciting show in the universe thanks to Contenders like us.[/p][p][img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/z4mnmfs6j6sv/4e1THBcLKRqdQdCh7g1Iz5/efdb335cf9ff049b8a98d57d9ab66532/KOM_2D_Cutouts_Coach.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]The best Contenders need a coach, but enough about you. I was self taught. Weapons, movement, Glory Moves, Trophies, progression, swagger. I know the Road to Stardom like the back of my dismembered hand.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Incoming arrows? Scars do wonders for personal branding. Buzz saws? Less hair means more agility. Rabid fans? Best to request donations. But any coach will say that. I’ve been to the bottom of the deepest lava pits, on top of the tallest spikes, and inside the most dangerous exploding barrels. Now, that makes for legendary experience.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Pop quiz. Who will be inducted into the [b][u][url="https://www.kingofmeat.com/en-us/news/articles/hall-of-pain"]Hall of Pain[/url][/u][/b] next season? If you said Coach Yurgurt, you’re smarter than I’d like to admit. The second best answer is you. They may have banned me as a Contender, but they can’t ban my legacy. Together we’ll skip the tryouts and shoot straight to the top.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Weapons[/b][/h3][p align="start"]How do you want to be known in combat? Wild card weapon wielder like me? Weapon specialist? How about a support Contender? There's a weapon for every playstyle. Four types of melee weapons and four types of ranged weapons to be exact. Here's the genius part, you can mix and match them any way you want. Looking for a sword and shield with a bomb launcher? Done. Hammers with crossbows? Pure devastation. I pioneered this strategy, naturally.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]My debut kicked off a new era for the Gax. I probably gave my teammates the biggest boost they've ever felt. But, after multiple waves of enemies and some broken strings and bones, I realised why should I support everyone, when I can just support myself?[/p][p][img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/z4mnmfs6j6sv/QZJ3DWP3c5F77Yri6u5yT/757ada681238278f845969dfe110bd8c/KoM_GDC_Screenshots_GuitarAxe_v01_1920.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Sword and shield offers perfect balance, medium speed, and medium damage. Hammers? Slow but DEVASTATING! I once flattened three enemies with one swing. Arcane Knuckles are my specialty: quick combos, lightning-fast strikes with less damage per hit. When you're as skilled as me, quantity becomes quality.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Following a formal complaint from the Bonepickers union, I was assigned ranged weapons. There’s crossbows, flintlocks, boomers, and bomb launchers. Pair Arcane knuckles with a bomb launcher like I did for pure tactical genius. Eventually I mastered everything in the Contender arsenal. As you level up, you'll learn more signature combos, unlock new weapons that better suit your style, and become immortalised through your favourite form of combat.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Sometimes your weapon chooses you, but you always choose your road to stardom.[/p][p][img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/z4mnmfs6j6sv/77PUECun2o8UKqdZTaMEcw/c8209364c2fef1f345973cad0c1fb601/KOM_SGF_2025_Screens_Combat_G_1080_CT-000018970.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Glory Moves[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Glory Moves! I’m not talking about myself gloriously moving up the Road to Stardom. No, we’ll save the best stuff for later. Let’s start with the Hot Potato—raw, round, explosive. A lot like my younger self.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Toss that spud between your allies for a little extra oomph. Just don’t take a bite. When you’ve got the best angle, boom—no matter who, or what, stands in your way. Want something sweeter? Grab a Cluster Duck. Not as charming as my record-breaking rookie season, but almost as deadly. Lost a limb or three back then to fowl play. If you’re even half the Loregokian I am... well, less is more right?[/p][p][img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/z4mnmfs6j6sv/5eQbEUmnDz46qkFPOHVb24/af813dc518cdb061d45bd3ec3df5cc57/02_GRAND_SMASHIONAL_1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]If the Hot Potato is a mighty single serving, the Cluster Duck is multiple courses of adorable destruction. Perfect against those big groups hungry for carnage from you little Contenders. Fearlessly slash forth amidst your feathery chaos. Still, massive destruction doesn’t mean we never take damage.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]The soothing heals of Essence Drain once carried my squad to the finish line. Of course, I carried that Essence Drain straight into spikes. Some unjustly call it the start of my decline. I call it a noble sacrifice.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Contenders these days got it good. Tons of enemies for the Essence Drain. That’s even more damage converted to health. Pair it with the Cluster Duck for fast team heals, if you have the coordination. The best Contenders, I’m talking about myself for once, we know teamwork, especially how to make the team work for us.[/p][p][img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/z4mnmfs6j6sv/3CaKjeQNbjMkLT39iraOTq/e0034cd08468ac23f2cb18e6473bfad8/04_CLUSTER_DUCK_1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Now you see why I’m the most overqualified coach for the next generation of Contenders. Get ready to show me how you will unleash your ridiculous when King of Meat releases on October 7.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Aspiring Contenders can [b][u][url="https://www.kingofmeat.com/en-us/shop"]pre-order[/url][/u][/b] King of Meat: Standard Edition or King of Meat: Deluxe Edition now for bonus content like the Venerable Defender Legendary Costume, a fearsome samurai-style outfit, with matching sword, shield, and stickers, plus up to 5 days of early access.[/p]

notes.title: Hall of Pain
notes.content: [p][b]Contender versus Dungeon Creator is more than just the mystical world of Loregok’s greatest pastime. Beyond the glitz, glamour, and celebrity media infatuation lies the true Loregokish dream—the Hall of Pain.[/b] [/p][p]The Hall of Pain immortalises the best of the best. No, the worst of the worst. Wait, the most ridiculous of ridiculous? No one knows the true criteria for entry, including its anonymous panel of expert advisors.[/p][p align="start"]How will you impress bloodthirsty, desensitised crowds of middle-class monsters in this economy? Persevere through colourful deathtraps, build your own fiendish dungeons, or outclass everyone with your distinct, soon-to-be trademark style.[/p][p align="start"]Before we move forward with the next generation of Contenders, we must first go back to where it all began. Join six-time champion and nine-time intensive care patient, Juliana Spiderhead, as she untangles the [b][u][url="https://www.kingofmeat.com/en-gb/game/annals-of-agony/first-age"]Annals of Agony[/url][/u][/b], a tantalising glimpse into the rich history of the greatest game show in the universe, King of Meat. Younger, or more relevant fans should know that up-and-coming King of Meat TV host Elixia Fangstar will share various community highlights following the game’s release on October 7th.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p][img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/z4mnmfs6j6sv/eYwFRzEsS43nw0BPKakDe/c7bdd40e4951ab40d151d7076b3fdf62/KOM_2D_Cutouts_Juliana.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Lore of Loregok: The beginning begins[/b][/h3][p align="start"][b]One day, mysterious TVs appeared. New things are confusing. Being confused makes people angry. Angry people fight. Fighting creates drama. Drama makes great TV. The rest is history.[/b][/p][p align="start"]Throughout the Annals of Agony video series, Juliana Spiderhead will provide a never before seen look at the show’s only banned weapon, take us closer than ever to the man inside the Buzzworth Billy costume, and more. Check out the latest episode before exploring the [b][u][url="https://www.kingofmeat.com/en-gb/game/annals-of-agony/first-age"]Annals of Agony tapestry[/url][/u][/b] for even greater untold King of Meat legends. All Ages are now visible courtesy of legal magic, bringing us to present day. How will you shape the future of Loregok? We cannot wait to see how King of Meat will become even more ridiculous through your stylish actions, wondrous creativity, and silly contributions.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p][img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/z4mnmfs6j6sv/4WRasT5cKIxApleRlkt78m/2749c17481ff3a3e0990f1fc04b774c8/KOM_AoA-903-BirthOfMeat_Thumb_1920x1080_YT_EN_CT-000013538.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]The End that (Seemingly) Never Ends[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Elixia Fangstar is best known for capturing the zeitgeist of Loregok. Elixia will host community spotlights, including notable dungeons, Contender accomplishments, and more. She rose to fame as a King of Meat superfan streamer, so she’s always listening for community feedback on how to improve her show. She might not know the secret formula to become a Hall of Pain inductee, but rumour has it she acquired insider knowledge when working the midnight hour as an intern for King of Meat TV.[/p][p align="start"]Elixia turned down a starring role in the August 21 KOM TV broadcast and has since been quoted saying she couldn’t pass up an opportunity to [i](redacted)[/i] for the upcoming the Hall of Pain site. Stay tuned for more information on the Hall of Pain and all things player immortalisation post-launch.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/z4mnmfs6j6sv/2C27x0NaCpJxdGablm64db/3dff6fb505f7c57d05430b94ee13016b/KOM_2D_Cutouts_CommunityHost.jpg"][/img][/p][p]King of Meat releases on Steam, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S on October 7, 2025. Aspiring Contenders can [url="https://www.kingofmeat.com/en-gb/shop"][u][b]pre-order[/b][/u][/url][u][b] [/b][/u]King of Meat: Standard Edition or King of Meat: Deluxe Edition now for bonus content like the Venerable Defender Legendary Costume, a fearsome samurai-style outfit, with matching sword, shield, and stickers, plus up to 5 days of early access.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1926980/King_of_Meat/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Discord Video Quest
notes.content: [p][b]We’re teaming up with Discord on a Video Quest to kick-off the road to release. [/b]This isn't the only way we're supporting the Discord community, you can also get involved with the official King of Meat server for Dungeon sharing, feedback, and more! [url="https://www.kingofmeat.com/en-us/forward-link?id=discord"][u][b]Join here[/b][/u][/url].[/p][p][/p][h3][b]King of Meat Quest[/b][/h3][p align="start"]This Video Quest is available now for all Discord users where premium services are available. Simply accept it on Discord and watch the King of Meat Release Date Trailer before 4:59 p.m. PT on August 28 to earn 700 Orbs. Orbs are an easy way to unlock Discord upgrades like Nitro credits, items from the main collections, and more. Check out Discord’s dedicated Orb [url="https://support.discord.com/hc/en-us/articles/30593690165783-Discord-Orbs-FAQ"][u][b]FAQ[/b][/u][/url] for more details.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Quest Completion[/b][/h3][p align="start"]The King of Meat Quest can be completed entirely through the Discord UI. Here’s how to claim your Orbs:[/p][list][*][p]Discord's premium services are restricted in some regions.[/p][/*][*][p]Select the Discover icon at the bottom of the server list on the left side of the app. This will direct you to the Discover page where you can explore available Discord Quests, by selecting the Quest tab within the Discover list. Please note, this Quest can be accepted on Desktop but must be completed in App.[/p][/*][*][p]The King of Meat Quest can also appear in the Quest bar above your Discord voice chat options.[/p][/*][*][p]Once accepted, the Quest bar will show your progress through a percentage bar.[/p][/*][*][p]Upon completion, you can visit the Quest in the Discover list to claim your reward.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]Additional information on Discord Quests can be found at [url="https://support.discord.com/hc/en-us/articles/22225719947543-Discord-Quests-FAQ#h_01JFAWCX89PT7F7ZCQP1KPBCQT"][u][b]Discord Support[/b][/u][/url]. Stay tuned to this site, along with our social channels for a second Quest closer to release featuring a custom King of Meat x Discord avatar decoration.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p][img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/z4mnmfs6j6sv/6mLxZiZWRAJXWSHyCIAy61/87d0048a72342d09a40df8136f50c385/KOM_SGF_2025_Screens_Combat_E_1080_CT-000018970.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"][b]The [url="https://www.kingofmeat.com/en-us/forward-link?id=discord"][u]King of Meat server[/u][/url] is the best place to reach our team. [/b]Say hello, meet other players, and provide feedback on how to make King of Meat better for every type of player. You can also look forward to community events, activities, and more after launch.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]King of Meat releases on Steam, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S on October 7, 2025. Aspiring Contenders can [url="https://www.kingofmeat.com/en-us/shop"][u][b]pre-order[/b][/u][/url] King of Meat: Standard Edition or King of Meat: Deluxe Edition now for bonus cosmetics like the Venerable Defender Legendary Costume, a fearsome samurai-style outfit, with matching sword, shield, and stickers, plus up to 5 days of early access.[/p]

notes.title: Technical Test Details
notes.content:
[p][b]Join the ultimate server challenge.[/b] This Technical Test will run from August 23, 10 a.m. PT until August 24, 10 a.m. PT on Steam, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S. The most-watched, sometimes controversial, but always talked-about survival gameshow awaits. Help influence the future of King of Meat, earn special rewards, and get famous or die trying alongside your friends.[/p][p align="start"]Everyone can join for an early look at King of Meat. We'll review participant feedback on as many features and systems as possible, including Create Mode and dungeon gameplay. 

Eager to race down the Road to Glory? [url="https://kingofmeat.com/en-gb/shop"][b]Pre-order now[/b][/url] and get 5 days early access to King of Meat on October 2. Want to learn more about the game? Check out our [url="https://kingofmeat.com/en-gb/news/articles/release-date"][b]release date announcement[/b][/url] for an overview of what to expect when King of Meat launches on October 7.[/p][p align="start"]Here's everything you need to know about Technical Test rewards, feedback, and more.
[/p][h2][b]Unleash Your Ridiculous[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157733/7351dccc450661f3b8c70982735d8d5d7dc9a5da.jpg"][/img][/p][p]King of Meat is a co-op party platformer, where up to 4 players must overcome nightmarish dungeons filled with puzzles to solve, challenges to traverse, and ridiculous monsters to fight. Progress through official and community built dungeons to unlock new abilities and gear on your way to become the ultimate Contender. You’ll have the tools to build dungeons and try out fellow Contenders, helping shape the experience for those that follow. Remember, if you can play it in-game, you can build it too![/p][p align="start"]King of Meat is better together. So why not embody the Loregokish spirit and subject your closest friends to your painstakingly crafted dungeons? Grab your squad or head to our [b][url="https://kingofmeat.com/en-gb/forward-link?id=discord"]official Discord channel[/url][/b] to makes some friends (or frenemies).[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Beta Rewards Top[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Hang out with your favourite Creator for 30 minutes of cumulative watch time during the Technical Test to claim your Beta Rewards Top. This reward will carry over into the full release.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157733/9c801c33436145ea6ff56f1f4e3361c4b665471a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]If you haven’t done so already, make sure your [b][url="https://kingofmeat.com/en-gb/twitch-drops"]Twitch account[/url][/b] is linked to your Steam, Xbox, or PSN account (depending on which platform you play on). Twitch Drops can only be claimed once per account.[/p][h2]
[b]Gargazel Bear Outfit[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Perfect for migration, if you're into that kind of thing. Plush footwear made of fur! Oh...[/p][p align="start"]Get the [b]Gargazel Bear skin[/b] when you link your [b][url="https://kingofmeat.com/en-gb/about-amazon-games-id"]Amazon Games iD[/url][/b] to your Steam, PlayStation Network, or Xbox account.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157733/f0506536d716ca70af8661a871b59c4eb5d16d9c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]If you’ve already linked accounts in the past, you’ll automatically receive your rewards. This reward will carry over into the full release.[/p][h2]
[b]How to Join[/b][/h2][p align="start"]There are no sign ups for the King of Meat Technical Test. Simply join by searching for either King of Meat on Steam or King of Meat - Technical Test on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.[/p][h2]
[b]Feedback[/b][/h2][p align="start"]To help us deliver the best possible experience at launch, feedback can be shared through our Discord. [b][url="https://kingofmeat.com/en-gb/forward-link?id=discord"]Join now[/url][/b] to connect and discuss your experiences with other Contenders![/p][p align="start"]Please do not engage in inappropriate in-game behavior during this test (spamming, cheating, exploiting glitches, etc). This test does not represent the player experience we will offer at launch. Please understand that we may need to disable the servers at any time during the test. If you witness any inappropriate in-game behavior, please notify us.[/p][h2]

Become a fearless Contender as you battle through and build devious dungeons for gory, gory, glory.[/p][p align="start"][/p][h3][b]Deluxe Edition Bonus[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Heroes get remembered, but legends never die, especially in Ironlaw Plaza where you can buy all of your favourite Contender merchandise. Develop your own style, starting with the Tapeboard Betsy and Emerson Shard Character Sets—exclusive to the Deluxe Edition—to stand out on the shelves and up at Komstruct Koliseum.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157733/0bbb5d5b10def5cd82f1cf5b3a5c8788f32956e3.jpg"][/img]Whether you prefer to conquer nightmarish obstacles or create the dungeon of your dreams, King of Meat celebrates player interaction. notes.title: King of Meat Overview - What to Expect
notes.content:
[p][b]Our teams at Glowmade and Amazon Games are excited to bring you into the world of Loregok on October 7. [/b]Whether you prefer to conquer nightmarish obstacles or create the dungeon of your dreams, King of Meat celebrates players and creators. We will continue to shape the future of the game together through your ongoing feedback.[/p][p align="start"]Our next step toward fostering that relationship is communications like this blog. We will strive to be open, communicative, and transparent about what’s coming at launch and in the future. While the specifics may change throughout development, here’s an early overview of our values.[/p][h3][b]
Our Values[/b][/h3][p align="start"]As Amazon Games and Glowmade worked together to develop the business model for King of Meat, we identified three core principles that embody our values, serve as our foundation, and guide our decision-making.[/p][olist][*][p][b]No pay-to-win:[/b] All purchases in-game are purely cosmetic and have no impact on game play.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Choice:[/b] All cosmetics are completely optional.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Transparency:[/b] There are no loot boxes or any other randomised form of monetisation. This means that players always know exactly what they are buying and how much it costs.[/p][/*][/olist][h3][b]Game Content[/b][/h3][p align="start"][b]King of Meat is a co-op party platformer, pitting up to 4 players against devious dungeons filled with puzzles to solve, challenges to traverse, and ridiculous monsters to fight. [/b]Progress through official and community-built dungeons to unlock new abilities and gear on your way to becoming the ultimate Contender.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157733/399052fd1d97d20eb0b636f9493b8073035a69aa.jpg"][/img][/p][p]There will be over 100 dungeons available at launch, but that number will quickly grow as the community pushes Create Mode to its limits. Most launch dungeons were meticulously crafted by Glowmade, while some came straight from the next generation of dungeon creators like you. These community-built dungeons were hand-picked from our ongoing playtests.[/p][p align="start"]Before we talk more about player impact, let’s first discuss dungeon categories.[/p][list][*][p][b]Multiplayer:[/b] Get famous or die trying alongside your friends. Multiplayer features curated dungeons sorted into "Leagues" of varying difficulty for parties and random squads.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Discovery:[/b] Dungeon creators pour their blood, sweat, and fears into crafting only the finest obstacle courses. Discover more joyfully unhinged dungeons and give new dungeon creators the recognition they deserve. From outrageous enemy gauntlets to methodical puzzles, nothing is off the table in King of Meat.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Specials:[/b] Whether you are crowned victorious or perish anonymously, you’ll need to impress your audience with stylish combos and over-the-top Glory Moves for a spot on the leaderboard. Make your name known through high score challenges like Slay of the Day and Dungeon of the Day.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Solo:[/b] Learn more about the colourful characters, corporations, and [url="https://kingofmeat.com/en-gb/game/world"][b]world of Loregok[/b][/url] in narrative-driven dungeons. You’ll also master weapon-specific training dungeons to hone your skills.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]These dungeons have been made with the same tools that you can use to create your own fiendish playgrounds. If you can play it, you can build it. We cannot wait to see how Loregok will become even more ridiculous through your stylish actions, wondrous creativity, and silly contributions.
[/p][h3][b]Future Updates[/b][/h3][p align="start"][b]King of Meat updates to the base game will be free for all players who’ve bought the game. [/b]While we aren’t ready to talk about post-launch support just yet, you can look forward to new game modes, player customisation options, Create Mode tools, regular events, dungeons, and more. Your feedback is always appreciated. Stay tuned for more details.
[/p][h3][b]Komstructor Collective[/b][/h3][p align="start"]The [url="https://www.kingofmeat.com/en-gb/community/komstructor-collective"]Komstructor Collective[/url] is a group of exemplary community members that love making dungeons. If you would like to join, please submit your dungeons in the [url="https://www.kingofmeat.com/en-gb/forward-link?id=discord"]King of Meat Discord[/url]. There are no restrictions or requirements on what you can build, we just want to help empower players that love Create Mode. We will also host "Build Challenges" for you to show off your creativity and potentially join the Komstructor Collective. If your creations catch our eye, we’ll reach out via Discord.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157733/fca15b88b2ae861c42ae144439332d74a6fe6ef6.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Komstructor Collector perks include:[/p][list][*][p]Featured in-game dungeons and title[/p][/*][*][p]Exclusive Discord channels[/p][/*][*][p]Appearance in the game credits for those that join pre-launch[/p][/*][*][p]Exclusive in-game Contender skin[/p][/*][*][p]Feedback play sessions[/p][/*][*][p]And more![/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Creator Programme[/b][/h3][p align="start"][b]Whether you are a Twitch streamer, YouTuber, wiki author, cosplayer, artist, musician, or anyone else who makes something to contribute to the love of King of Meat, we want to find ways to support you.[/b] Collaborate with the King of Meat team and other creative members of the community through our [url="https://kingofmeat.com/en-gb/community/creator-program" buttoncolor="#ffea00"][b]Creator Programme[/b][/url].
[/p][p align="start"]There are no requirements to apply other than a desire to create great King of Meat content. Learn more and sign up on our Creator Programme page.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]The Hall of Pain[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Following launch, the Hall of Pain will celebrate past and present King of Meat players. To maintain recognition for only the most iconic players, the criteria for induction may change over time, possibly resulting in some being removed as new, more deserving players are added. How will you leave a trail so legendary it gets written in lore? We’ll introduce the Hall of Pain in more detail post-launch alongside additional plans for player celebrations in-game as well as across our website and social media.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Character Customisation[/b][/h3][p align="start"][b]Few survive the dungeons of Komstruct Koliseum, so which of your looks will leave a lasting impression beyond each dungeon into the cold, dry eyes, and warm pitter-pattering hearts of fans everywhere?[/b][/p][p align="start"]Embrace chaotic customisations across outfits, weapons, accessories, Glory Moves, emotes, banners, stickers, and decorations. In Ironlaw Plaza, cosmetics can be obtained in exchange for gold (earned through dungeons) at vendors in the hub area, as rewards for leveling up the Road to Glory progression system, and through accomplishments called Triumphs. If you want to be a Contender with more options for striking looks, all you really need to do is play the game.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Stamps[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Further bolstering the customisation selection are special items available in exchange for Stamps at the Beast Shall Ride (BSR) Shop in Ironlaw Plaza.[/p][p align="start"]Stamps are a form of currency that can be earned through gameplay, including events and Triumphs. Stamps can also be obtained from the Xbox, PlayStation, and Steam stores.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Early Access Overview[/b][/h3][p align="start"][b]Pre-ordering either the Standard or Deluxe Edition of the game will give you up to 5 days early access, beginning on October 2. [/b]To learn more about each edition, check out our [url="https://www.kingofmeat.com/en-gb/news/articles/release-date"]release date announcement[/url]. All progress, including cosmetics, dungeons, and Road to Glory level will carry over from early access into the full release on October 7.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157733/0bbb5d5b10def5cd82f1cf5b3a5c8788f32956e3.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]FAQ[/b][/h3][p align="start"][b]Is King of Meat free to play?[/b][/p][list][*][p]No, King of Meat is not a free to play game. The Standard Edition and Deluxe Editions will be [url="https://kingofmeat.com/en-gb/shop"][b]available[/b][/url] on October 7. An active subscription to Xbox Live or PlayStation Plus, depending on your platform of choice, will also be required to play.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]How do I get early access to King of Meat?[/b][/p][list][*][p]King of Meat will release on October 7. Players that pre-order either the Standard or Deluxe Editions will receive 5 days of early access to the game, beginning on October 2.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Which platforms can I play King of Meat on?[/b][/p][list][*][p]King of Meat will be available on Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5, and Steam (PC) on October 7. King of Meat will release on Nintendo Switch 2 at a later date.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Is an internet connection required to play?[/b][/p][list][*][p]Yes, an internet connection is required to play all content in King of Meat.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Will King of Meat receive free game updates in the future?[/b][/p][list][*][p]Yes, players who purchase King of Meat will receive free updates that introduce new gameplay features, Create Mode tools, and other content to Loregok. Stay tuned for more details.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Looking Ahead[/b][/h3][p align="start"]We’re thrilled to invite players to help influence the future of King of Meat in the [url="https://kingofmeat.com/en-gb/news/articles/technical-test-details"][b]Technical Test[/b][/url]. Unleash your ridiculous in Create Mode, become the ultimate Contender, and earn special rewards on August 23, 10 a.m. PT until August 24, 10 a.m. PT on Steam, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157733/7351dccc450661f3b8c70982735d8d5d7dc9a5da.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The [url="https://kingofmeat.com/en-gb/forward-link?id=discord"][b]King of Meat Discord[/b][/url] is the best place to reach our team. Say hello, meet other players, and provide feedback on how to make King of Meat better for every type of player. You can also look forward to community events, activities, and more after launch.[/p][p align="start"]Don’t forget to also join us on our social channels to stay up to date with all things King of Meat.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]We look forward to battling through dungeons with you in Loregok soon![/p]

notes.title: King of Meat is certain to make dungeon crawlers, brawlers, and creators smile
notes.content:
It's a tough time to be a new multiplayer game, whether that be a competitive PvP title or a co-op PvE affair like Amazon's upcoming dungeon crawler, King of Meat. But the most successful tend to do at least one of these two things: deliver experiences that make you smile, or keep you hooked with high ceilings of challenge. After going hands-on with King of Meat at Summer Game Fest in LA, I can say with confidence that it'll do the former, and that it has the tools in its arsenal to achieve the latter, too.

notes.title: King of Meat: Lights, Camera, ALPHA! Details
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z4mnmfs6j6sv/4P1y6J02zvxcXYdgHSoQ4N/869073b11e96fa7baaaa4e642729a24e/KOM_Announce_IRONLAW_08_1920x420.jpg?fm=webp[/img]
Become the ultimate Contender, inspire the next generation of Dungeon Creators, and unleash your ridiculous during King of Meat: Lights, Camera, ALPHA!

With the test arriving next week, we wanted to share additional details on what participants can expect. For players that missed the announcement, we provide a brief overview below. [url=https://www.kingofmeat.com/en-us/tester-sign-up]Sign up now[/url] for a chance to begin your road to stardom as the next Contender on the most exciting show in the universe. All you need is a weapon and a dream.

Learn more about the focus of the confidential, closed alpha and key test details. All feedback helps create an even better launch experience for all players.

[h2]Test Overview[/h2]
Fame, fortune, and gory, gory, glory await in King of Meat: Lights, Camera, ALPHA! We’re excited to invite players on PC and Xbox Series X|S to the world of Loregok for the first time from December 4 through December 14.
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z4mnmfs6j6sv/4JIkTIxLjfpwb0PLSrF2Bp/89c10e93bf193cacbb0e39cd3145acc8/KOM_Xbox_Closed_Alpha_16x9_Titled_Hero_Art_1920x1080_CT-000012953_WEB.jpg[/img]
This invite-only, confidential alpha will give players in North America and Europe an early look at King of Meat, like a tantalizing pilot episode that gets even better after invaluable feedback (and a few casualties). Step into the role of fearless Contenders battling through ridiculous Dungeons, build devious creations, and outshine everyone with dazzling custom appearances.

[i]This is a confidential playtest of King of Meat. Your participation in this pre-release test is subject to the Non-Disclosure Agreement in Section 2.8 of our [url=http://www.amazon.com/help/ags/terms]Terms of Use[/url]. By participating, you agree to keep it strictly confidential. You may not disclose, in any form, content from this playtest. This means no streaming, posting of videos, or sharing images from this pre-release version of the game. Any breach of confidentiality will be treated seriously.
[/i]
[h3]Test Goals[/h3]
[previewyoutube=ehBAn64695o;full][/previewyoutube]

To help us deliver the best possible experience at launch, we'll review participant feedback on Create Mode, Dungeon gameplay, and more. We want to hear your feedback on as many features and systems as possible, including the number of thrown controllers. Our target is zero.

Feedback can be shared either through:
[list]
[*] The in-game feedback survey, accessible via the QR code on the main menu.
[*] A private Discord server used exclusively for this test. Players that have been selected for the confidential, closed alpha will receive a Discord invitation alongside their beta code via email. Only invited players will be able to access the private Discord server.
[/list]
[h3]Game Overview[/h3]
In the world of Loregok, where flocks of local dragons hunger for fame, neighborhood trolls crave funds to pay rent, and global corporate commercialism thirsts to quench its bottom line, comes a fresh source of raw entertainment — you.

[previewyoutube=xPmUWMUKWQY;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Become the Ultimate Contender[/h3]
Some of you yearn for the spotlight as Contenders. Others may have taken a wrong turn on their way to the restroom. Those desperately seeking fame and fortune can enter joyfully unhinged Dungeons built by both the developers and the community. From outrageous enemy gauntlets to methodical puzzles, nothing is off the table in King of Meat.

[h3]Inspire the Next Generation of Dungeon Creators[/h3]
Take Dungeon creation into your own hands in Create Mode, where you're given the tools to create Dungeons of your dreams — and someone else’s nightmares. All of the Dungeons in King of Meat have been made with the same tools you'll use to create your own fiendish playgrounds. If you can play it, you can build it.

[h3]Unleash your Ridiculous[/h3]
Heroes get remembered, but legends never die, especially in Ironlaw Plaza where you can buy all of your favourite Contender merchandise. Develop your own style to stand out on the shelves and up at Komstruct Koliseum. Ironlaw Plaza features all of the latest trends in customization — like edible sausage hammers. You never know when your stomach will grumble during a rumble.

[h2]FAQ[/h2]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z4mnmfs6j6sv/3O9KokyNKF8DG3lOtsPpU2/51c6deb7316caa3b0ebaa1edd8c6461f/KOM_Announce_Screenshots_WeaponsAndCharacters_3_1920.jpg[/img]
Here’s everything you need to know ahead of the confidential closed alpha:

If I already signed up to be a King of Meat tester, do I need to sign up again for the King of Meat: Lights, Camera, ALPHA!?
[list]
[*] No, you only need to sign up to become a play tester once. We will contact you if you have been selected to participate in King of Meat: Lights, Camera, ALPHA! or any future tests.
[/list]
Which platforms are eligible to participate in the King of Meat: Lights, Camera, ALPHA!?
[list]
[*] King of Meat: Lights, Camera, ALPHA! will be available on Steam (PC) and Xbox Series X|S.
[/list]
Which regions will participate in the King of Meat: Lights, Camera, ALPHA!?
[list]
[*] North America and Europe.
[/list]
Which languages will be supported in the King of Meat: Lights, Camera, ALPHA!?
[list]
[*] English audio and text will be supported in the King of Meat: Lights, Camera, ALPHA!. Additional languages will be available in the full release.
[/list]
Do I need Game Pass Core to participate in the King of Meat: Lights, Camera, ALPHA! on Xbox Series X|S?
[list]
[*] Players will not need an online subscription to participate in the King of Meat: Lights, Camera, ALPHA!.
[/list]
Can I play with a controller on PC during the King of Meat: Lights, Camera, ALPHA!?
[list]
[*] Yes, the King of Meat: Lights, Camera, ALPHA! will have support for controllers on PC.
[/list]
If I get access to the King of Meat: Lights, Camera, ALPHA!, can I stream or create content about the game?
[list]
[*] No, the King of Meat: Lights, Camera, ALPHA! is under NDA. Sharing, recording, or broadcasting any King of Meat: Lights, Camera, ALPHA! test content or gameplay is strictly prohibited.
[/list]
Will progression from the King of Meat: Lights, Camera, ALPHA! carry over to the full release?
[list]
[*] Progression during playtests will not carry over to the final game.
[/list]
Do I need an internet connection to play?
[list]
[*] Yes, an internet connection is required to play King of Meat. 
[/list]
How will I be notified if I am selected to participate?
[list]
[*] If selected to participate, we will email you a code with instructions for downloading the King of Meat: Lights, Camera, ALPHA! by December 3. 
[*] Codes will be sent out in batches after December 3 too, so fear not Contender, you still might have an opportunity to test your skills in the Koliseum.
[/list]
Where can I get support for the King of Meat: Lights, Camera, ALPHA!?
[list]
[*] Accepted testers for King of Meat: Lights, Camera, ALPHA! will receive an invite to our private test Discord for support.
[*] You can also get support for Amazon Games iD through our Amazon Games iD Support channels.
[*] If you signed up via the Xbox Insider Program, please visit their website for support.
[/list]
What are the minimum and recommended PC specs?

Minimum System Requirements:
[list]
[*] OS: Windows 10
[*] Processor: Ryzen 3 1200 or equivalent
[*] Memory: 8 GB RAM
[*] Graphics: GTX 1060 5GB / RX470 4GB
[*] DirectX: Version 12
[*] Storage: 11 GB available space
[/list]

Recommended System Requirements:
[list]
[*] OS: Windows 10
[*] Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-8700K or equivalent
[*] Memory: 8 GB RAM
[/list]

[url=https://www.kingofmeat.com/en-us/tester-sign-up]Sign up now[/url] for a chance to participate and stay tuned to this site, along with our social channels for future updates.

notes.title: King of Meat is co-op Dark Souls mixed with Fall Guys, and you can try it early
notes.content:
King of Meat is easily one of my most anticipated games right now. The co-op dungeon crawler trades raw skills for controlled chaos, and this makes it a total joy to play with absolutely anyone. It's got Dark Souls-esque combat, Fall Guys antics, and friendly fire shenanigans that'd make even the most seasoned Helldivers 2 players burst out laughing. If that sounds like something you'd enjoy, developer Glowmade is about to do an alpha test, and you can sign up for a chance to play right now.

Read the rest of the story...
